openjdk version "21.0.13" 2026-10-20 LTS

method.branchConstruction: 200 main-line moves; optionally a 20-node side branch per preceding main-line node

paces.burst: 201 prepared responses without a deliberate delay
paces.navigation-burst: burst immediately after marking recent navigation; preserve the existing 450ms navigation pause

method.engineInput: Controlled valid analysis responses from existing request-test fixtures; synthetic 3x3 metadata trees, not engine search or legal-game throughput
method.finalFence: One setMovelistAll completion after the final response
method.threadCounts: JFR ThreadStart/ThreadEnd, stack traces disabled, lifecycle deduplicated by thread ID
method.cpuAndAllocation: Cumulative worker counters sampled through each worker’s last node update; exclude exit/callback work, threads cancelled before any node, producer allocations and native thread stacks; instrumentation overhead remains included
method.settlement: Completion callback time; the subsequent 50ms idle retirement wait is excluded
method.metadataOracle: All public NodeInfo fields for primary/secondary and main-line/variation metadata, plus last-move candidate ranks; compare hash across versions and to an additional settled traversal in every run
